title: messages v0
description: A message catalog: the words of the desk or of one plugin in one language (ADR 0250). A catalog is one JSON file named by its language (en.json, ko.json) in the folder a plugin's manifest names as messages, or in a runtime module's messages folder. English is required and complete; another language may lack ids, which then read in English.

MessageCatalog.description: Message id to message, in one language.

MessageId.description: A message's id: camelCase words joined by dots, the first naming the module or area (frames.notResponding).

Message.description: One message: a text, or a plural message whose form the count parameter picks.

MessageText.description: A message's text. {name} is replaced by the parameter of that name; a parameter not given reads as nothing. A lookup with no parameters at all leaves the text as written.

PluralMessage.description: A message in plural forms, keyed by the Intl.PluralRules categories of the catalog's language; the count parameter picks the form, and other is the form for any count the language has no other category for.
